Attach in this order: middle / dark / bright.

Blend these three bracketed interior photos into one natural MLS interior.

Image 1 is the middle exposure: use it for composition, geometry, furniture, color, and all property details.
Image 2 is the dark exposure: use it only to recover windows, lamps, and clipped highlights.
Image 3 is the bright exposure: use it only to recover shadows and dark corners.

Align the frames. Remove ghosting from curtains, fans, trees, and reflections. Recover only the real window view in the dark frame. Do not invent a view.

Bright, clean, dimensional interior. Neutral whites, real wood, controlled highlights, open shadows. No heavy HDR.

Keep the exact architecture, camera angle, framing, furniture layout, materials, wall colors, flooring, windows, doors, landscaping, neighbors, and property condition. Preserve Sony 3:2 aspect ratio and original composition. Do not crop. Do not add, remove, move, enlarge, or redesign permanent features. Photoreal MLS photo, not illustration. No fake HDR, no halos, no neon grass, no orange interiors, no warped rooms, no new windows, no text, no watermark.
